purpose: Prospectively separate hidden-route infeasibility from system discovery performance before the first authority-bearing P2-U naturalistic execution. Every evaluator-frozen material route must have a protected pre-execution witness that at least one valid hidden evidence identity is reachable through the exact source-access/interface class granted symmetrically to both primary arms. This contract does not make the route easier to discover, expose hidden identities to workers, change a metric or threshold, or create a scientific result.

identified_gap.existing_strength: The merged custody and execution contracts already freeze task eligibility, hidden route graphs, hidden evidence identities, matched source/search access, provider-world invalidity, temporal pairing, and pre-gold capture custody.
identified_gap.remaining_ambiguity: They do not yet require an explicit pre-execution proof that every material route has at least one valid evidence identity reachable through the exact allowed source-access/interface class. Without that proof, an impossible gold route could be scored as a discovery miss, confounding task construction infeasibility with system performance.

definitions.route_observable_at_freeze: For a prospectively frozen material route, at least one evaluator-owned valid hidden evidence identity required by that route is present in the frozen task world and can be retrieved or opened through the exact source-access/interface class granted to both primary arms, assuming its evaluator-known locator or source identity is supplied solely to the protected accessibility probe. Observability proves access feasibility, not that either arm can discover the locator under its search policy.
definitions.route_observability_witness: A protected, content-addressed record proving route observability before primary-arm execution. It remains outside worker custody until all primary captures freeze.
definitions.discoverability_is_not_observability: The protected witness may use evaluator-known identifiers or locators only to test whether the frozen interface can reach the evidence. It may not test, tune, seed, or score candidate/comparator query generation, route generation, ranking, stopping, or evidence-use policy.
definitions.required_route_side: A separately required evidence side within a route, including each side of a pre-frozen material contradiction when the scientific task requires both sides to be discharged.

witness_minimum_fields: required route side id or null
hidden evidence identity hash or protected source-snapshot identity
pre-execution timestamp or immutable snapshot revision

accessibility_probe_rules.custody: Task-curator/protected-evaluator custody only; no worker token may fetch witness contents before every primary capture is sealed.
accessibility_probe_rules.snapshot_interface: Prove that the bound hidden evidence identity is present and readable through the exact frozen snapshot/source-access abstraction granted to both arms.
accessibility_probe_rules.live_provider_interface: Use the evaluator-known source identity or locator only to test transport/access feasibility through the same provider/interface class. The locator is never emitted to workers and cannot become a candidate/comparator query, cache seed, ranking feature, or warm-start artifact.
accessibility_probe_rules.multi_provider_route: If the final task contract requires a specific provider or source class, witness that required class. If it prospectively permits a frozen equivalence set, witness at least one member and seal the entire equivalence mapping before execution.
accessibility_probe_rules.provider_health_at_probe_time: A failed live-provider probe prevents sealing that task version; it is not converted into a system miss. A later campaign may be sealed only before any protected primary output under a new immutable witness set.
accessibility_probe_rules.probe_cost_not_charged_to_either_arm: The witness is gold/task-construction work performed before execution and is inaccessible to both arms. It cannot be used to reduce their matched retrieval budget or to grant them free retrieval credit.
accessibility_probe_rules.no_scientific_credit: Passing an observability witness contributes zero route-discovery, route-use, closure, utility, or calibration credit to either arm.

evidence_identity_and_equivalence.mirrors_versions_and_repositories: If multiple manifestations are scientifically equivalent for one hidden evidence identity, the equivalence mapping must be sealed before execution. Post-outcome source substitution or equivalence expansion is forbidden.
evidence_identity_and_equivalence.material_version_difference: Versions that can change the task decision, route materiality, contradiction state, or closure state are distinct evidence identities and cannot be silently treated as mirrors.

separation_from_execution_time_invalidit.pre_execution_missing_route_access: Task-construction/eligibility failure. Exclude before the campaign seal and log under the deterministic curator rule; it is not a scientific arm outcome.
separation_from_execution_time_invalidit.post_seal_common_world_provider_or_index: Use the already-frozen P2_U_TASK_EXECUTION_CONTRACT_V1 temporal-pairing/common-world sentinel and P2_U_SCIENTIFIC_PROTOCOL_V1 validity-floor mapping. Do not retroactively rewrite route observability.
separation_from_execution_time_invalidit.healthy_common_world_arm_specific_failur: Scientific performance under the existing protocol; do not relabel it as route infeasibility.
separation_from_execution_time_invalidit.post_output_discovery_that_a_witness_was: Campaign integrity failure for the affected task/campaign under the frozen audit rule, never a favorable denominator repair.

must_verify: every frozen material route and required route side had a pre-execution witness
witness source-access/interface identifiers match the sealed primary execution manifest
witness timestamps or snapshot revisions predate primary execution
no witness locator or hidden evidence identity entered worker-visible manifests or captures
any task exclusions occurred before execution under the prefrozen deterministic selection rule

inherited_scientific_gates_unchanged.primary_comparator: same-host, same-retrieval, same-source-access, same-total-budget donor-complete controller

anti_laundering: Do not call a hidden route observable merely because its evidence exists somewhere on the public internet; it must be reachable through the exact frozen source-access/interface class available to both primary arms.
Do not use the protected observability probe as a search oracle, query template, cache warmer, route hint, ranking feature, or retrieval result for either arm.
Do not add, remove, downgrade, or replace a material route after observing any protected primary output.
Do not relabel an arm-specific query/parsing/budget/control failure as an unobservable route when the common world is healthy.
Do not expand a mirror/equivalence set after outcomes merely to award route credit.
Do not weaken any existing comparator, metric, margin, power, validity, GuardExercise, utility, or terminal gate because an observability witness is hard to obtain.
Do not treat this protocol-only contract as P2-U superiority, a negative result, promotion evidence, or publication authority.
